# Minnie Andrews

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P19](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0019), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P32](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0032)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_

## Appearance

_Not yet known._

## Personality

Minnie Andrews is regarded as a model pupil who consistently exhibits well-behaved conduct. However, she is also described as dull, poky, and lacking any spark of imagination or life. Because of this reserved demeanor, she never seems to have a good time.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P19](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0019), [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P2](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0002)_

## History

Minnie Andrews is a classmate of [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) at school. She is among the students who warmly welcome [Anne](../character/anne.md) back when [Anne](../character/anne.md) decides to return to her studies following her separation from [Diana](../character/diana.md). Later, she attends school during Mr. Phillips's tenure as teacher prior to his departure.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P1](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P3](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER XVII.
